title: HTTP Lifecycle Plan Artifact Persistence
summary: The FP-MCP-256 HTTP lifecycle plan artifact persistence tool was implemented, exposed, and verified using the existing FP-MCP-254 non-executing request artifact REQ-20260703T231957999Z-32fcb25f. The tool reused the FP-MCP-255 adapter validation, recorded planId HTTPPLAN-20260703T233517042Z-9242deff, and wrote runs/FP-MCP-254/opencode-http-lifecycle-plans/HTTPPLAN-20260703T233517042Z-9242deff.json. The plan artifact was committed as supporting evidence at ForgePilot commit 6976d2e. The tool returned planRecorded=true, adapterRan=true, lifecyclePlanReady=true, requestArtifactValid=true, requestedModelId=deepseek-v4-pro-high, requestedRunMode=DESIGN_ONLY, requestState=CREATED_NOT_STARTED, repoCommit=5e9cf3e, lifecycleToolName=forgepilot_run_opencode_http_lifecycle_orchestrator, lifecycleApprovalRequired=RUN_OPENCODE_HTTP_LIFECYCLE_ORCHESTRATOR, lifecycleCleanupDefault=true, executionAuthorized=false, approvalConsumed=false, runnerStartEndpointContacted=false, opencodeStarted=false, and lifecycleInvoked=false.
caveats: The plan artifact persists hashes and lifecycle readiness metadata, not raw prompt text.
The plan artifact is not a lifecycle invocation record.
The tool records a plan only after adapter validation succeeds.
The plan artifact was stored under the source request packet directory FP-MCP-254 because that is where the existing request artifact lives.
boundaries: No runner start endpoint was contacted.
